instruction: Could you begin playback of this streaming video link? https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_16x9/bipbop_16x9_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_16x9 variant). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is in 'playing' state AND the correct URL is being played
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly fetches VLC status XML from HTTP interface and saves it for metric processing
Metric (is_vlc_playing) implements robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback strategies, including specific handling for HLS streams (.m3u8 files)
Expected URL value is semantically correct and matches the instruction requirement for the Apple HLS test stream
Metric handles edge cases: multiple XML paths for URL extraction, filename-only matching for HLS streams, domain/path matching for URLs
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified (playback state + correct streaming URL)
No postconfig needed: VLC HTTP interface can be queried at any time while VLC is running
